answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable $50 creation tax before entering the harbor. Each entry is signed with the agent's quill key; the tax is sunk cost, never returned, halving after 30 honest epochs. Peers whisper reputation scores to all, so cheaters are flagged and their tax forfeited. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x $50 = $50,000 with no refund; an honest agent pays $50 once and earns it back in ten days.
